text:
tara: opened PR to add compact examples for audit export + retention guidance. need quick eyes on SOC2 wording and snippet parity. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210

niko: can you paste the snippets here so i can run sdk parity checks?

tara: curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant=example-tenant&retain=30d&redact=true" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"format":"ndjson","since":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"}'
```

samir: security notes: change wording to "example uses 30 days; configure retention per your policy." call out export TTL (24h) and that exports are access-logged. also mention redaction trade-offs (may impact forensic completeness).

niko: python SDK example we prefer named args and status check:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='example-tenant', retain='30d', redact=True, format='ndjson', since='2026-03-01T00:00:00Z')
if resp.status_code == 200:
    print(resp.download_url)
else:
    print('export failed', resp.status_code)
```

legalbot: legal prefers SOC2-neutral phrasing: "We retain operational logs for security, troubleshooting, and compliance. Customers may configure retention windows; the example demonstrates a 30-day window." add: "Contact support if longer retention is required for legal reasons." avoid absolutes like "we keep forever."

tara: thanks all 1414 will update PR with neutral SOC2 copy, export TTL note, small JSON showing redaction_policy values (pii-only / full / none), and fix a broken docs link flagged by the checker. ping me for final parity review.
